summary: A customer whose Paystack window closed is left with a pending booking and no way to finish paying. The change adds a Pay again button on the My bookings list for pending bookings. It touches the My bookings table, the payment step and the verify call.

criteria.text: On My bookings, a booking with the status pending shows a Pay again button, and confirmed or cancelled bookings do not.
Pressing Pay again opens the payment step for the deposit of that booking, and after a successful payment the booking shows as confirmed.
If the customer closes the payment window again, the booking stays pending and the customer sees the same message and can press Pay again once more.
If the booking was cancelled in another tab, Pay again does not confirm it and the customer sees that the booking is cancelled.
If the customer presses Pay again twice quickly, only one payment is started for the booking.

findings.title: Unpaid bookings hold the slot with no expiry
findings.plain: A new booking is saved as pending and its time is treated as taken, but nothing ever releases it if the deposit is never paid.
findings.costIfIgnored: Slots stay blocked for people who walked away, so real customers see no free time and the salon loses bookings.
findings.fixPrompt: In server.js, give pending bookings an expiry time and ignore expired pending bookings when listing free slots in /api/slots. Keep the Pay again button working only while the booking has not expired.

findings.title: Same Paystack reference can confirm many bookings
findings.plain: When a payment is verified, the app confirms the booking with the reference it was sent but never checks whether that reference already confirmed another booking.
findings.costIfIgnored: One deposit could be used to confirm several bookings, and a Pay again button makes repeated verify calls more likely.
findings.fixPrompt: In the verify route in server.js, reject a Paystack reference that is already stored on another booking, and store the reference with a uniqueness rule.

findings.title: Cancelled booking can be confirmed by a late payment
findings.plain: The verify route does not look at the booking status, so a booking that was cancelled can still be marked confirmed when a payment arrives.
findings.costIfIgnored: A customer who pays again on a cancelled booking is shown as confirmed for a slot that may already be given to someone else.
findings.fixPrompt: In the verify route in server.js, refuse to confirm a booking whose status is cancelled and tell the customer to book again.

findings.title: The request does not say how long a booking can wait for payment
findings.plain: The request mentions a payment window that closed but does not say how long a pending booking may be paid for later.
findings.costIfIgnored: The coding agent will guess a time limit, and customers may lose a slot sooner or later than the owner expects.
findings.fixPrompt: Ask the owner how long a pending booking should be kept, then write that time limit into the acceptance criteria before building Pay again.
